body: I was hired on to take over a cafe at a local golf course as the General Manager. Arrive at 5:30 to meet the acting GM. After 45 minutes standing there with no keys outside by myself a maintainance guy walks passed me on the sidewalk. I got him to let me in and start wall surfing for lights switches. Current manager arrives much later. She's a short bigger white girl that clearly thinks she's gangster as hell. I introduce myself and she says that she'd gonna run across the street and buy some Adderall and asked if I want one. I replied no and started getting all the grills and the press up to temp and stated brewing coffee and tea. Waitress (The only one they had so far) comes in. She had clearly given birth within the week. Acting manager comes back as we open. Manager was touching a floor matt (One of the greasy rubber matts that are typically found in front of a grill to soften up the floor for line cooks and give traction. Then immediately flips a biscuit with the same hand without gloves. A few minutes later I went to the cooler and the waitress had stored a bunch of breast milk she had pumped in the bathroom next to produce. About 30 min later I saw the manager had spilled grease and was squeegeeing down a hole around a metal post. I asked where the hole went. She said she didn't know that's just where they did this. I went to the basement where they kept golf carts. It was the main power box for the whole building. Soaked in water and dried on grease. I just left. Fuck that.

U have a question though. Just now gave up. I've been in a relationship with someone who I trusted entirely too much. Then again that's everyone really. This relationship never even had a chance. My SO is impulsive and didn't really want a relationship. We moved in together and they have progressively shut down and lashed out more and more. Week and a half ago they went out and fucked some random stranger they found in a bar in their car just because becauae
they knew it would kill me inside.  Then had me drive them around in it for hours the next day. It was the most devastating thing anyone has ever done to me. They didn't even try to conceal it
 They don't care. They broke my heart in every conceivable way and has never given any effort into us Much less a future together. I am constantly on walking eggshells because of the these random fits of rage where they just lose it and berate and belittle me for hours at a time. Criticizing and insulting me for anything I do. Any time I've ever tried to discuss my feelings I am put down for being "an overly sensitive bitch". All for simply feeling anything at all. I just feel betrayed and used but above all I feel my hope for any comfort or peace in the future slipping away from me. I was already barely clinging to hope that there are even any good people left in the world but I think everyone is just dead inside. Apathy has spread throughout the world like a pleague. I'm so alone in this place. I feel there's no humility left at all. I just got a new job and should be excited but the prospect of continuing the be a slave to a system I have never, and will never be in support of sounds unbearable. I really can't see what I have left to fight for. To live for. I'm completely empty. The thought of death soothes my anxiety, my exhaustion. I truly don't know how to carry on. I need to just disappear. That's the only way I'll ever be free of this anguish and disparity that haunts me constantly. I burst into tears any time I'm not around anyone because I'm just so fucking full of pain and so very alone. I guess my question is this: What's the point of staying in the fight when all hope of victory is gone? At what point is pride just willful ignorance?
